Name: The Gift of Friendship
Author: DyBlz3156
Description:
[left][color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]1. Friendship Rewards 友谊奖励[/b][/size]
[/color][b][size=4][color=#6d9eeb]2. Community Center Enhancement 献祭流增强
3. More Stardrop Tea 更多星之果茶
[/color]
[/size][/b][/left][size=3]When you reach [/size][b][color=#00ff00]2 hearts[/color][/b][size=3] with the friendly local villagers, you can enter their rooms to claim[/size][b] [color=#00ff00]a specially prepared gift box[/color][/b][size=3]. New areas also bring new gift boxes (e.g. desert)! Of course, all bundles used to restore the Community Center will be reorganized and increased difficulty, but their rewards have been enhanced accordingly. You'll no longer complain about the trivial rewards.
At the start, you will receive a cup of [b][color=#00ff00]Stardrop Tea[/color][/b] instead of seeds or hay.[/size]
[size=3]This mod is actually a [/size][b]VBScript[/b][size=3] that does [/size][b]not require SMAPI support[/b][size=3]. It can be run directly to modify your game save.

当你与居民交往至[b][color=#00ff00]2心[/color][/b]时，便可进入他们的房间领取[b][color=#00ff00]一份具备个人特色的礼包奖励[/color][/b]，除此之外解锁新的区域也会获得一份独一无二的礼包(例如沙漠)。同时，社区中心收集包的挑战难度增加，数以万计的难以预料的收集包将重新混合，但是相应的奖励也会增强。
游戏开始，你将收到一杯[color=#00ff00][b]星之果茶[/b][/color]，而不是种子或干草。
该模组实际上是 [b]VBScript[/b] 脚本源码，因此[b]不需要 SMAPI 的支持[/b]也可以运行，它能够直接作用于你的存档。[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=4][b]How to Use 使用说明[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=3][b]Copy the VBScript into a new save folder, then run the script directly until you see the completion prompt.
将脚本文件拷贝到一个新的存档文件夹中，然后直接运行脚本，直到弹出加载成功的提示。[/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=4]Compatibility 兼容性[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Must be used with the [b]vanilla map[/b] ([b]not compatible with mods that modify the map[/b]).
Must be used on [b]a new save[/b] (because bundles will be reorganized).
必须是原版未修改的地图 (因此不兼容修改了原版地图的模组)；
必须应用在一个新的存档 (涉及到献祭收集包的重组)。

Hope you have fun, endorse the mod if you like it! If the idea is popular, I will gradually release more gift boxes compatible with SVE, RSV, and ES characters and areas.[/size]
[size=3]希望各位老乡能够玩得开心~ 如果喜欢还请多支持。[/size][color=#ffff00][b]*^ v ^*[/b][/color]
[size=3]如果你觉得这个想法受欢迎，我会开始制作兼容SVE、RSV和ES等模组的角色和区域的礼包。[/size]
